parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed and delivered a comprehensive project for a 58 m² apartment in Vienna, Austria. The project brought together interior design, technical documentation, the design and manufacture of custom furniture, furnishing and procurement, and a turnkey renovation of the apartment.

In developing the interior, particular attention was paid to the functional use of floor area, ergonomics, and the organization of storage systems. In a 58 m² apartment, it is important to make good use of every meter while preserving the feeling of an open, comfortable, and visually cohesive space.

The custom furniture was designed alongside the interior, which made it possible to integrate furniture solutions and storage systems directly into the architecture of the apartment. This approach helps use the available space efficiently and maintain a unified stylistic concept throughout the interior.

Before implementation began, a detailed cost estimate was prepared covering the required work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and other items specified in the project. Once the design stage was complete, a turnkey renovation of the apartment was carried out in Vienna in accordance with the technical documentation.

This 58 m² apartment project showcases DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s end-to-end approach to delivering residential interiors in Vienna — from developing the design concept and technical solutions to manufacturing custom furniture and carrying out the renovation work.
